name: Billing Sub Service Qualifier 1 Code
definition: Qualifies the content of the subservice code.

LBOX.name: Lockbox
LBOX.definition: Subservice code contains a lockbox number which identifies the lockbox using the service.

STOR.name: Store
STOR.definition: Subservice code contains a store number which identifies the store using the service.

BILA.name: Bilaterally Agreed
BILA.definition: Meaning of the subservice code is established by the trading partners.

SEQN.name: Sequence Number
SEQN.definition: Subservice code is an arbitrary sequence number used to uniquely identify this Service and prevent duplicate services within this statement.

MACT.name: Member Account
MACT.definition: Subservice code is the account number of a member of a relationship structure. This allows a parent statement to include the same service as rolled up from its member accounts and still avoid duplicate service identification within the statement.
